config.label: Base URL of the Robyn gateway (gasless quote/route/execute API)
config.description: Base URL of the Robyn gateway (gasless quote/route/execute API). Optional — defaults to https://api.anygas.xyz/svc.

config.label: Optional hex private key
config.description: Optional hex private key. If set, the server signs and submits gasless intents autonomously; if omitted, it returns unsigned intents for the agent/user to sign.
